title: Barnes v. Yahoo — an undertaking and a promise
shortTitle: Barnes v. Yahoo — an undertaking and a promise
summary: The problem reports different treatment of a negligent-undertaking claim and a promise-based claim concerning removal of abusive material.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

After repeated requests about false profiles, Barnes received a personal assurance from Yahoo’s representative. The text reports dismissal of the tort route under the statutory publisher provision while allowing the promise-based route to proceed. It then asks the reader to apply § 90’s elements. The reported decision is not a final finding that all elements were proved, and this notebook does not update the statute or its later case law.
